program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_b@j, !is_bos@j & !is_c@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@i & !h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & !is_c@j, !h2_1@i & !is_bos@j)
h4_1 = rightmost(!h2_1@i & h3_1@i & !is_bos@j, !h2_1@i & h3_1@i & !is_bos@j & h2_1@j & !h3_1@j)
accept = !is_bos & !h4_1

output accept
